[EFFECT_RELAY_TEAR] effect "effect" writes its compute output into "signal" on every run, and nothing else writes "signal" — it is derived state kept one flush late: everything reading it paints a frame behind everything reading the source. The written value is "signal" itself: read "signal" where "signal" is read (or createMemo it if a stable derivation is needed) and delete the effect.
